name: Kilab/Daniel (son with Abigail)
title: David's firstborn in Hebron
summary: Kilab, also called Daniel, was David's second son, born in Hebron to Abigail from Carmel. He was the son of the wise woman who had previously been married to Nabal. Kilab is mentioned only in the genealogies and played no known role in the struggle for succession after David.

keyEvents.title: Born in Hebron
keyEvents.description: Chileab was born as David's second son while David was king in Hebron. His mother was Abigail, the widow of Nabal from Carmel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In Chronicles he is called Daniel and mentioned as the second of David's sons born in Hebron.
